biography_sections.title: Ballyboggy tenant evidence and the 1733 exclusion
biography_sections.markdown:
John Glasgow is directly documented as Ballyboggy co-lessee in **1740**. He remains an uncertain working son of inferred younger John-3990; no record states the relationship. The 1733 Kilroot entry is a lost-original Connor administration-bond index with no kin or death-date detail, and must not be treated as the same personally active 1740 lessee without resolving the chronology.

Sources: PRONI `D2223/15/56`; [PRONI Name Search](https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx).
